description: Test suite for absl::Cord and related internal functions, focusing on cordz (cord tracking) features, including construction, assignment, modification, and subcoring, with conditional compilation based on ABSL_INTERNAL_CORDZ_ENABLED.

classes.name: CordzUpdateTest
classes.description: Test fixture for testing Cord modifications with different sizes and sampling intervals.

classes.name: CordzStringTest
classes.description: Test fixture for testing string-based Cord operations with various sizes.

methods.name: InitialOr
methods.description: Returns the appropriate method identifier based on the size of the Cord.

methods.name: MakeString
methods.description: Creates a string_view of a specified size filled with dots.

methods.name: MakeAppendStringCord
methods.description: Creates a Cord with a sampled method of appending a string of a given size.

methods.name: TestParamToString
methods.description: Converts test parameters to string labels for test naming.

methods.name: ParamToString
methods.description: Converts test parameter info to string labels.
